dependencies.purpose: The console reads and mutates through the same tenant-bound control API, including liveness and readiness probes.

connections.detail: Browser-reachable API origin; local development uses port 8000.

local_replacement.detail: Serve the control API inside the deployment. The public web build embeds its API origin; changing only the container environment does not retarget that build.

dependencies.failure_behavior: The console reports an unavailable or degraded API; a successful liveness probe alone is not readiness.

dependencies.purpose: Public console origin and permitted browser origins constrain login navigation and cross-origin requests. These are not autonomous API dial targets. The host cookie prefix is cookie-scope metadata; AXIS_CSRF_HOST_COOKIE_NAME is a web source constant naming the API-issued readable CSRF cookie, not an environment setting or remote host.

connections.detail: Browser navigation to the same locally hosted console; development uses port 3000.

local_replacement.detail: Host the console within the boundary and use matching public origins and identity callbacks.

dependencies.failure_behavior: A wrong origin can prevent cross-origin or browser authentication flows; no alternate origin is admitted by this inventory.

dependencies.purpose: Persist tenant-owned operational state and audit evidence. The packaged Temporal service also uses PostgreSQL.

connections.detail: Control-plane database and separately configured Temporal database schemas.

local_replacement.detail: Use an operator-managed local PostgreSQL deployment. SQLite fixtures are not a production PostgreSQL substitute.

dependencies.failure_behavior: Database-dependent requests, writes and workflow persistence cannot be assumed available. Backup and restore procedures remain separate evidence.

dependencies.purpose: Share rate-limit admission across API processes through a Redis-compatible service.

connections.detail: TLS and service port follow the selected Redis-compatible deployment.

local_replacement.detail: Use local Redis or the packaged Valkey service. Production validation requires the Redis backend and closed failure mode.

dependencies.failure_behavior: With the required production closed failure mode, unavailable admission storage rejects requests rather than falling back to an uncoordinated counter.
dependencies.condition: Required for production; optional only where the existing configuration permits an in-memory development backend.

dependencies.purpose: Back separately enabled TypeDB ontology queries and mutations.

connections.detail: The packaged service also exposes a separate HTTP interface on container port 8000.

local_replacement.detail: Use local TypeDB for live graph operations. The Postgres reference graph is a limited reference path, not feature parity.

dependencies.failure_behavior: Live TypeDB-dependent operations cannot complete when unavailable. Disabling those features is an explicit capability omission.
dependencies.condition: Enabled ontology query or mutation runtime; omit only with both capabilities disabled.

dependencies.purpose: Execute workflows, register schedules and deliver governed workflow signals.

connections.detail: API and worker connect through their existing Temporal ports.

local_replacement.detail: Run Temporal locally. The worker connects even when maintenance schedules are paused.

dependencies.failure_behavior: The worker cannot poll or register schedules without Temporal. Signal/outbox behavior follows the existing adapter and retry ownership.

dependencies.purpose: Validate the configured issuer and obtain signing keys from the configured or derived JWKS endpoint.

connections.detail: Issuer/JWKS service inside the deployment; the development Keycloak uses port 8080.

local_replacement.detail: Use a local supported OIDC provider and its local JWKS endpoint. Cached keys do not remove future key refresh dependencies.

dependencies.failure_behavior: Unknown or unverifiable signing keys cannot establish identity. Key cache lifetime and provider failure behavior need runtime acceptance tests.

dependencies.purpose: Exchange authorization codes and refresh tokens through the configured identity token endpoint.

connections.detail: Back-channel token exchange; client credentials remain in existing secret handling.

local_replacement.detail: Provide a local token endpoint. Moving only JWKS locally does not make login and refresh independent of the provider.

dependencies.failure_behavior: Login or refresh fails when token exchange cannot complete. The inventory grants no cached-authentication bypass.
dependencies.condition: Browser login or refresh flow is enabled.

dependencies.purpose: Record identity redirects separately from API-to-provider network calls.

connections.detail: Authorization, callback and logout navigation must all remain browser-reachable inside the boundary.

local_replacement.detail: Use local provider, API callback and console logout origins; keep the existing exact callback and cookie controls.

dependencies.failure_behavior: A remote or unavailable navigation target interrupts browser login/logout even when the API is locally hosted.
dependencies.condition: Browser authentication and provider logout paths are configured.

dependencies.purpose: Store source envelopes and export artifacts behind the existing object-store adapter.

connections.detail: A configured S3-compatible artifact endpoint; not the input source endpoint.

local_replacement.detail: Use local MinIO for shared S3-compatible storage. Local filesystem mode is a distinct single-host option, not WORM or multi-node parity.

dependencies.failure_behavior: Object-store-dependent extraction or export cannot complete if payload writes/reads fail. Durable acceptance remains with existing ingestion owners.
dependencies.condition: S3 artifact adapter selected; local filesystem does not require this network connection.

dependencies.purpose: Read an approved input bucket through deployment-owned profiles and lease-scoped credentials.

connections.detail: Actual profile endpoint; private endpoint and credential fields are references, not extra dial permission.

local_replacement.detail: Use a local approved S3-compatible source. Only explicitly allowed loopback fixtures permit insecure HTTP; real profiles retain TLS.

dependencies.failure_behavior: Unavailable or denied sources do not authorize checkpoint advancement. Lease, egress and ingestion dispatch gates remain authoritative.
dependencies.condition: S3 source ingestion explicitly enabled with approved source profiles.

dependencies.purpose: Read the selected external PostgreSQL source through the existing lease and runtime egress boundary.

connections.detail: DSN identifies the source; endpoint reference and digest are evidence, not credentials or new targets.

local_replacement.detail: Use an approved local read-only source and existing supported material resolver. An unsupported secret provider is not silently replaced.

dependencies.failure_behavior: Denied or unavailable source access cannot be treated as successful ingestion. Checkpoint and retry authority remain in the ingestion host.
dependencies.condition: Live discovery or extraction enabled with an approved source and execution context.

dependencies.purpose: Execute model requests using the registered endpoint and configured allowlist, not arbitrary URLs from prompts.

connections.detail: Port is selected by the approved local model deployment. The allowlist is not the endpoint registry.

local_replacement.detail: Serve a compatible model inside the boundary and preload weights before runtime. A local URL by itself is not provider conformance evidence.

dependencies.failure_behavior: Disabled, denied, unsupported or unavailable providers cannot produce a verified model result. No automatic public-provider fallback is introduced.
dependencies.condition: Model routing execution is enabled and a compatible endpoint is registered.

dependencies.purpose: Export optional OTLP HTTP traces and metrics.

connections.detail: Collector endpoint inside the deployment; downstream collector exporters require their own local configuration.

local_replacement.detail: Disable export or use an operator-provided local collector. The Compose collector block is commented, not an active packaged service.

dependencies.failure_behavior: Telemetry delivery can be lost or delayed when the collector is unavailable; application availability is not proof that export succeeded.

dependencies.purpose: Serve application assets and package-supplied Geist fonts from the built console.

local_replacement.detail: Include static assets and font files in the web artifact. The inspected layout imports package fonts, not a remote font stylesheet.

dependencies.failure_behavior: Missing build assets break rendering or typography. Layout inspection alone does not certify every browser request.

dependencies.purpose: Keep operator runbooks, status links and infrastructure consoles distinct from automatic support uploads.

connections.detail: Operator navigation; development consoles use the listed non-production ports.

local_replacement.detail: Publish local runbooks/status pages and restrict infrastructure consoles. No remote support upload is implied by a configured link.

dependencies.failure_behavior: Unavailable links or consoles remove diagnostic visibility; they do not establish or revoke application authority.

dependencies.purpose: Resolve approved logical services inside the deployment.

connections.detail: Local resolver over UDP and TCP; external forwarding must be explicitly reviewed.

local_replacement.detail: Provide local service discovery and review resolver forwarding. Network policy enforcement belongs to the later zero-egress slice.

dependencies.failure_behavior: Name-based connections may fail or resolve incorrectly when service discovery is unavailable. Inventory checks never resolve names.

dependencies.purpose: Maintain time used for tokens, leases, certificate validity and workflow scheduling.

connections.detail: Host-owned time source, not an Axis-created client. A trusted offline clock is also an operator option.

local_replacement.detail: Use a trusted local time source or controlled offline clock procedure. Axis has no separate time configuration authority.

dependencies.failure_behavior: Clock drift can invalidate identity, lease and scheduling assumptions. No automatic public-time dependency is asserted from source inventory alone.

dependencies.purpose: Supply certificate trust and renewal material for local TLS endpoints.

connections.detail: Any certificate issuance, renewal or revocation traffic is deployment-owned and must be reviewed separately.

local_replacement.detail: Distribute a local CA trust bundle and offline or local renewal procedure. The shipped development Keycloak is not a production TLS profile.

dependencies.failure_behavior: Missing or expired trust material can prevent TLS communication. Disabling certificate verification is not a local replacement.

dependencies.purpose: Acquire locked packages, container images and tooling before runtime.

connections.detail: Package registry or reviewed mirror during build/install/upgrade.
Container registry or preloaded release artifacts, not normal application traffic.

local_replacement.detail: Prepare and verify artifacts before disconnecting. Production of the complete offline bundle belongs to issue 474.

dependencies.failure_behavior: A disconnected installation or upgrade fails if an artifact is missing; successful runtime inventory does not prove installability.

dependencies.purpose: Acquire compatible inference weights and provider dependencies before starting a local model service.

connections.detail: Only build/install/upgrade acquisition; no runtime model download is authorized.

local_replacement.detail: Preload reviewed model artifacts in the inference deployment. Axis does not ship a verified universal model bundle.

dependencies.failure_behavior: A provider missing required weights cannot serve inference; inventory alone cannot mark it ready.
dependencies.condition: A local model provider is part of the selected capability profile.
